title: Hainanese Chicken Rice
subtitle: Singaporean poached chicken with fragrant rice and dipping sauces
excerpt: The national dish of Singapore: an entire chicken poached gently in an aromatic broth until silky and just cooked, the cooking liquid used to cook the rice and serve as soup, with chilli sauce, ginger paste, and soy on the side.

recipe.sourceNotes: Hainanese chicken rice is considered the national dish of Singapore, despite its origins in Hainan province in southern China. The dish was brought to Singapore and Malaysia by Hainanese immigrants and evolved into the Singaporean version known worldwide today. The preparation involves poaching a whole chicken at a very gentle temperature (the water barely simmers) to produce meat that is silky and tender with a gelatinous quality from the collagen in the skin. The poaching liquid is then used in three ways: to cook the rice (producing a richly flavoured, slightly oily rice), as a light soup, and as the base for the ginger and spring onion sauce. The dish is always served with a chilli sauce, a ginger paste, and a dark soy dressing. The technique of plunging the chicken in ice water immediately after poaching tightens the skin and gives the characteristic bouncy texture.

content.text: The water must never boil during cooking; keep it at a bare tremble, about 80 to 85°C. A rolling boil produces tough, stringy meat. The ice-water bath immediately after poaching is essential for the characteristic silky, slightly gelatinous skin texture. The rice must be cooked in the chicken fat and poaching liquid for the authentic flavour.

content.text: Rub the chicken inside and out with salt and place in a pot just large enough to hold it. Cover with cold water. Add the sliced ginger, spring onion bundle, 3 garlic cloves, and 1 tsp salt. Bring to a very gentle simmer over medium heat. Reduce heat to maintain 80°C. Poach for 40 to 45 minutes. Remove the chicken and immediately submerge in iced water for 15 minutes. Strain and reserve the poaching liquid.

Fry the minced garlic in the oil in a saucepan. Add the rinsed rice and fry for 1 minute. Add 600 ml of the reserved poaching liquid. Bring to a boil, reduce to the lowest heat, cover, and cook for 12 minutes. Rest 10 minutes.

Joint or slice the chicken. Brush with sesame oil. Serve over the rice with cucumber, spring onion, and coriander. Provide small dishes of soy sauce, the grated ginger mixed with a little oil, and chilli sauce for dipping. Serve the remaining broth as soup alongside.
